verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is a hosted inference service, and whether its source is openly licensed is a fair openness question for a software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the service's source is published under an open license. The GitHub item covers only a client SDK, with no license stated, and the "open-source model" mentions refer to the third-party models it hosts. Neither counts as the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
